text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I... ran away. Yeah, that's right. I ran
away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Everyone else faced the Mejiro name in
their own
way. But I...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I just ran. I wasn't strong enough to face
the thing
I'm supposed to love.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So I ran away... Away from the Mejiros to

somewhere I could be myself... even if
that self
was weak.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
And sure enough, I found that place.
But...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
That weakness showed itself at the
spring Tenno
Sho. I couldn't show my
true self because I hadn't
overcome that
weakness yet...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
If I keep going like this, am I ever gonna
be able
to be my true self?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Will I become someone that everyone'll
be proud
of?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
What up, bestie?! Let's go slay at
karaoke! ♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
We gotta get hyped before the
Takarazuka
Kinen! All right? Let's go! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: A-ah, sorry. I can't today...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: What, for realsies? You're no fun...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Then, how about some bubble tea?! Or
we could
record an UmaTok! Or do a
conveyor-belt-sushi
crawl and just get
desserts?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... I don't feel like doing any of
that...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Compared to Daitaku Helios, she sounds
rather
gloomy.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what's the matter? You sick of
having fun or
something?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Or, wait... Don't tell me you're sick of
me?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Nah, I still love ya... Obvs.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
That's why I've always had so much fun
with you.
So I could run away from things
that are painful.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I've been leaning on you, and that's why
I've
stayed weak...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: What are you saying...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
What's the big deal?! There's nothing
wrong with
having fun! Who wouldn't
want to live doing only
the things they
like?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Who wouldn't want to run away from
painful
things?! If you can have fun
running and have fun
winning, then
what's the problem?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You're stronger now, Palmster! I know it!
You're
just short on confidence vibes
right now, that's
all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm no stronger than before... You're just
saying
that to be nice...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: You know what? Fine.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'm outta here! Dummy! You big dumb
idiot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daitaku Helios runs off somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... I thought I'd managed to run
away, but I
guess I didn't make it
anywhere after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wherever I go, the same old weak
Palmer catches
up to me. No matter
what, she'll always creep up
from behind
eventually.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
McQueen and Ryan have always worked
on
themselves without running away
from anything.
That's why they can take
pride in themselves...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
But I just wanted to have a good time. I
guess you
could say I haven't done my
time yet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Depending how you look at it, you could

probably argue that having fun is the
same as
running away. All the same...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You're saying taking time off to have fun
was...
necessary?
choice_data_list: I think it was time well spent, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, I see. You got a point there!
choice_data_list: Front Runner Umamusume usually catch their breath midway, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
That's right. I never knew how to take a
step back
and breathe before, so I
always felt like I was
suffocating.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
But then I went over to freestyle races
and
learned how fun it is to run the way
you want.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I did so many things I never had before
and
figured out who I really am.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I needed that time, just like you said.
That's why I
was able to start over.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
But ever since I did, I've felt like I'm
behind
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I just can't get into it while I'm here
feeling like
I'm nothing compared to
McQueen and Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
If I can't stand up and be, like, "Running
away is
the best! Eat your hearts out!"
then how can I go
out and party right
before a race?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The silence is heavy. She needs to find
her
strength—the strength of a Mejiro
who has lived
her life differently than
the others...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Until she does...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer. Do you have a sec?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems she's been waiting here in
ambush.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of us talk over everything we
can
possibly do for Mejiro Palmer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer? About my next race, I'm
thinking—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hold up! We gotta talk!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios comes in humming with a
low
intensity.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hey, Helios... Sorry about bef—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Don't apologize! We've got something
more
important to hash out!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You've legit got something no one else
has,
Palmster. All fax, no printer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: If you're trying to comfort me...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'm not trying to comfort you! I'm
speaking the
truth!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Your runaway is totally legit! No one can
keep up
with you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
That was just out of desperation... It was
straight
up born out of my weakness.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's not exactly something I can hold up
my head
and brag to my family about.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That's not it! Running away did so much
for you!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
There's so much you would never have
seen if you
hadn't! Like, a stupid amount
of stuff!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: What? You mean there are things I've seen only because I ran away?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! You would've never met your
trainer if
you hadn't run away, for one!
Or me either!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
And now we've been through so much
together!
And that's not about to
change any time soon,
'cause what we've
got is legit!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You can bet the other Mejiros don't
have friends
like this. You're the only
one!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I met you two because I ran... If I
hadn't...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... You're right. If I had been strong
from the
start, I wouldn't have met either
of you... You're
something special that
only I have...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
And I'm not just any friend. I know
everything
about you, Palmster! ☆ Call
me a expert!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You're super fast, and a bigger baddie
than
anyone! ☆ Even if you don't believe
in yourself, I
believe in you! Forever and
ever!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Helios...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
But you're just exaggerating... I'm
nothing
special...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Enough of that! Get this through your
head
already!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I know you waaay better than you know
yourself!
You know why?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Because I love you waaay more than you
love
yourself!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Helios...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So I'm gonna keep telling you until you
get it!
You're legit! You're fire! You're
legit fire!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'll tell you while you're training, while
you're
taking a break, while you're in the
bath, and even
before races! I'll be
shouting it from the stands!
And if that's
not enough...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: If that's not enough...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios pulls out a piece of
paper. It's the
secret weapon we came
up with in our discussion.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I'll even shout it from right beside you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
But you're right beside me now... Wait,
what's
that paper?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
It's a sign-up sheet... for the Takarazuka
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I've got a lot of followers so I can run
there even
though I'm on the Mile tour.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: You'd really do that? For me?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: You bet. Now... is there?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Uh, is there what?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Is there any other Mejiro with a friend
like me?! A
friend that'll even run your
races with you?! Who'll
run right beside
you if that's what it takes to get
you
fired up?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: No! Because I'm...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Runaway Palmster's exclusive runaway
bestie!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
My... runaway bestie...
...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Well? Whaddya think?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't that get you at least a little
hyped?
Doesn't it make you kinda, I
dunno, proud of me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios, the goddess of the sun
who
taught Mejiro Palmer about
freedom, works her
magic once more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Again, she shines her light on Mejiro
Palmer,
illuminating the path we took to
get where we
are.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
There's no way... I wouldn't be hyped.
There's no
way anyone else has someone
like you...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You're wild. You don't think about
consequences
or pros and cons...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
And you're always right by my side!
There's no
one else like you in the whole
world!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You said it! And I'm telling you you got
it,
Palmster! You got what no one else
has! You've
got me!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
And what we've got deserves to be
treasured!
Together, we can take on
anything!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So whaddya think? We running the
Takarazuka
Kinen or what?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hellz yeah, we're running! How could I
say I no?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You wanna run with me? Run and run as
far as we
can go?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Bet! If it's the two of us together...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
We can go anywhere! We've gotta go
out there
and flaunt it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Let's show everyone our double-slay

runaway!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I'm gonna run in the Takarazuka
Kinen! I
might not be good enough right
now, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
That's exactly why I was able to find a
bestie to
make up for what I'm missing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Together, we're the whole package! As
long as
the two of us are together, I've
got all the
confidence I need to show
everyone what it's
really like to party!

text_block_list.name: Palmer and Helios
text_block_list.text: Waheeeyyy! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Side by side with the friend she could
only meet
because of her troubles,
Mejiro Palmer is headed
to the
Takarazuka Kinen.
